import { Box, type Geometry, type Vec3 } from '@caemble/core'

export const Solid: Geometry<{ size: Vec3 }> = ({ size = [1, 1, 1] }) => <Box id="shape" size={size} />

async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    sound = await sim.run(tasks["acoustics"])
    await sim.record("pressure", sound["artifacts"]["pressure"])
    await sim.record("pressureProbe", sound["artifacts"]["pressureProbe"])
    sim.release(sound["artifacts"])
    sim.release(sound["state"])
